items.title: Edwin "Squirrel" Ashcraft Interview, 1961-08-16
items.q: Then Isham Jones was important to us because of some of the people in the band.

ctx.x: I can remember trios. I can remember the all-star trio. That was with George Hamlin Green on xylophone, and Victor Arden, I think it was, on the piano. And as the orchestras grew, it was at first thought that you couldn't have three saxophones playing at once, or the needle wouldn't stay on the record, or there'd be some money that you couldn't hear anything. Then Isham Jones was important to us because of some of the people in the band.
Well, that was later, though. That was a long 24, wasn't it? Yeah. That's about the first time you began to hear pop in.
